link.note: Probably disproven as John's ancestor (Round 3): Jacobus (TAG 12:199–204, 13:221) shows the Hannah Brewster in this family was a daughter of Rev. Nathaniel Brewster and widow of John Muncy who married John Thompson's SON Samuel; John Thompson's only recorded wife was Mary. Older sources (Thompson 1918 vol. 2 p. 310, vol. 3 p. 295; F. K. Smith 1967) made her John Thompson's wife (m. 12 June 1663) and mother of Elizabeth; Thompson and Wikipedia (Selah B. Strong) called her a daughter of Jonathan Brewster and granddaughter of Mayflower Elder William Brewster — false: Jonathan Brewster's daughter Hannah married Samuel Starr at New London in Dec 1664 (WikiTree Starr-3; Champlin 1915). Final removal awaits reading Jacobus directly.

summary: Daughter of Rev. Nathaniel Brewster who married John Muncy and then Samuel Thompson of Setauket; once shown as John's 10th-great-grandmother, but not John's ancestor.
bio:
Hannah Brewster was born on 19 May 1679, a daughter, most probably, of the Rev. Nathaniel Brewster; her family was not descended from the Mayflower Brewsters. She married first, at Brookhaven on 16 January 1703, John Muncy, who died on 12 June 1707, and second, at Setauket on 6 November 1709, Samuel Thompson. She was the mother of Susannah Thompson Strong and grandmother of Captain Selah Strong, so that Samuel's descendants carry both Thompson and Brewster blood. Hannah died on 7 November 1755 and was buried with Samuel at the south-east corner of the Setauket Presbyterian churchyard.

She was once shown as the wife of John Thompson and John's 10th-great-grandmother. Her marriage to Samuel Thompson instead makes that link probably wrong, and she is not counted as John's ancestor.
sources: Thompson, History of Long Island (1918) vol. 2 p. 310; vol. 3 p. 295

researchNotes:
Round 1 (correction 3e) had made her a daughter of Francis Brewster of New Haven and sister of Rev. Nathaniel (per F. K. Smith via jrm); Round 3 makes her Nathaniel's daughter married to Samuel Thompson. The deep-dive report (Behling) had flagged one register giving Hannah's husbands as Muncey and Samuel Thompson. Her marriage to Samuel Thompson makes Samuel's descendants (Selah Strong etc.) double Thompson–Brewster descendants.

B. F. Thompson's family account ([R4-S1]) gives her dates (b. 19 May 1679, d. 7 Nov 1755), her first marriage to John Muncy (16 Jan 1703; he d. 12 Jun 1707) and her second to Samuel Thompson (6 Nov 1709), and says she and Samuel are buried at the south-east corner of the Setauket Presbyterian Church. She was the mother of Susannah Thompson Strong and grandmother of Selah Strong. Not John's ancestor.
